digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI workflow / Ubuntu runner job occupancy
propositions: Ubuntu jobs occupy 30–35 runner-minutes per Verified run while macOS critical path is 20–30 minutes, creating queue contention despite functional test coverage

Bridge cadence test reads and parses workflow YAML 1,440 times inside a minute-check comprehension, costing ~6 runner-seconds per test; hoisting to a single pre-check preserves exhaustive proof while eliminating I/O overhead

Pandoc corpus tests execute real binary for all 884 prose units but assert only cardinality existence; moving full replay to scheduled external workflow and replacing legacy oracle subprocess with static fixtures preserves coverage while reducing per-change execution

Same-change Gerrit Verify runs with always() job predicates do not cancel stale predecessors, blocking admissions for 25 minutes; replacing always() with !cancelled() unblocks replacements while preserving full fallback on classifier failure
Post-remediation organic runs measure 22–26 minutes end-to-end with sub-30s individual test phases, meeting the target band without reducing coverage or adding runners
